{{Top|leg}}
The '''gallon''' was a a measure of liquid capacity. There existed containers that could hold a half-gallon, and buckets that could hold five of them.<ref name="COTJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>

[[Ice cream/Legends|Ice cream]] could be measured in gallons. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] claimed to be bringing a hundred gallons of [[Beebleberry ice cream/Legends|beebleberry ice cream]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Courteous]]'' as part of his gambit to bypass the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[ThonBoka]].<ref name="lando3">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''</ref>
